items.text: The image displays a user interface for an "API Debug Center" with a navigation sidebar on the left. The "MCP Manager" section is currently active and highlighted in the sidebar. The main content area shows the details for the "MCP Manager," described as a tool to "Manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) features and resources," including screenshots, task dispatch, and prompt mappings. A prominent notice indicates the user is "Not logged in" with a clickable "Login" button. Below this, there's another section for "MCP Manager" displaying three tabs: "Screenshot Management," "Task Dispatch," and "Prompt Mappings." The "Screenshot Management" tab is currently selected, offering options to "Upload Screenshot" and "Batch Upload & Merge."
